verdict.rationale: Asana's app directory lists a Slack integration that turns messages into tasks and comments, and a GitHub integration that syncs pull request status to tasks. GitHub is also covered by data-sync connectors, and the directory shows a broad catalog of other integrations. Google appears only through partner tools that mention Google Workspace generally, with no native Google Drive integration evidenced. missing for 10: an explicit native Google Drive integration, detailed setup docs for the Slack and GitHub integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration that they work.
